dashboard.label: Dashboard Governance
dashboard.description: Monitor, flag, and enforce policies on wasteful or problematic dashboards

div.style: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 16px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius: 6px;

search.query: | inputlookup governance_audit_log_lookup | sort - timestamp | head 1 | eval display = strftime(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") . " - " . action . " by " . performed_by | table display
| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | stats count

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | rex field=eai:data max_match=100 "<search>(?<search_block>[\s\S]*?)</search>" | eval search_count = mvcount(search_block) | where search_count > 10 OR match(eai:data, "earliest=-\d+[dh]|earliest=@") | stats count

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | rename eai:acl.app as app, eai:acl.owner as owner | join type=left label [ | search index=_internal sourcetype=splunk_web_access uri_path="*data/ui/views*" earliest=-30d | rex field=uri_path "/servicesNS/[^/]+/(?<app>[^/]+)/data/ui/views/(?<label>[^?]+)" | stats count as access_count by label ] | fillnull access_count value=0 | where access_count < 5 | stats count

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | rex field=eai:data max_match=100 "<panel>" | eval panel_count = mvcount(eai:data) | where panel_count > 15 | stats count
| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | where match(eai:data, "earliest=-30d|earliest=-90d|earliest=-1y|earliest=0") | stats count

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | rename eai:acl.app as app, eai:acl.owner as owner, eai:acl.sharing as sharing | rex field=eai:data max_match=100 "<search>(?<search_block>[\s\S]*?)</search>" | rex field=eai:data max_match=100 "<panel>" | eval search_count = if(isnull(mvcount(search_block)), 0, mvcount(search_block)) | eval panel_count = if(isnull(mvcount(eai:data)), 0, mvcount(eai:data)) | eval has_long_range = if(match(eai:data, "earliest=-30d|earliest=-90d|earliest=-1y|earliest=0"), 1, 0) | eval has_all_time = if(match(eai:data, "earliest=0"), 1, 0) | eval waste_score = (search_count * 2) + (panel_count * 1) + (has_long_range * 10) + (has_all_time * 20) | where waste_score > 15 | eval waste_reason = case( has_all_time=1, "All-time searches", has_long_range=1, "30+ day time range", search_count > 15, "Many searches (".search_count.")", panel_count > 15, "Many panels (".panel_count.")", 1=1, "Complex dashboard") | table label, owner, app, sharing, search_count, panel_count, waste_score, waste_reason | rename label as "Dashboard", owner as "Owner", app as "App", sharing as "Sharing", search_count as "Searches", panel_count as "Panels", waste_score as "Waste Score", waste_reason as "Issue" | sort - "Waste Score"
| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 | stats count by eai:acl.app | rename eai:acl.app as app | fields app

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/ui/views splunk_server=local | search isDashboard=1 isVisible=1 | rename eai:acl.app as app, eai:acl.owner as owner, eai:acl.sharing as sharing | search app=$filter_app$ sharing=$filter_sharing$ owner=$filter_owner$ | rex field=eai:data max_match=100 "<search>(?<search_block>[\s\S]*?)</search>" | eval search_count = if(isnull(mvcount(search_block)), 0, mvcount(search_block)) | eval has_long_range = if(match(eai:data, "earliest=-30d|earliest=-90d|earliest=-1y|earliest=0"), "Yes", "No") | eval has_realtime = if(match(eai:data, "earliest=rt|latest=rt"), "Yes", "No") | eval waste_score = (search_count * 2) + if(has_long_range="Yes", 10, 0) + if(has_realtime="Yes", 20, 0) | eval status = case( waste_score > 40, "Critical", waste_score > 25, "Warning", waste_score > 15, "Review", 1=1, "OK") | table label, owner, app, sharing, search_count, has_long_range, has_realtime, waste_score, status | rename label as "Dashboard", owner as "Owner", app as "App", sharing as "Sharing", search_count as "Searches", has_long_range as "Long Range", has_realtime as "Real-time", waste_score as "Waste Score", status as "Status" | sort - "Waste Score"

index=_internal sourcetype=splunk_web_access uri_path="*data/ui/views*" earliest=-7d | rex field=uri_path "/servicesNS/[^/]+/(?<app>[^/]+)/data/ui/views/(?<dashboard>[^?]+)" | where isnotnull(dashboard) | timechart span=1d count by dashboard limit=10

index=_internal sourcetype=splunk_web_access uri_path="*data/ui/views*" earliest=-7d | rex field=uri_path "/servicesNS/[^/]+/(?<app>[^/]+)/data/ui/views/(?<dashboard>[^?]+)" | where isnotnull(dashboard) | stats count as "Views" dc(dashboard) as "Dashboards" by user | sort - Views | head 10 | rename user as "User"

| inputlookup governance_audit_log_lookup | search action="*dashboard*" | eval time = strftime(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - timestamp | head 20 | table time, action, search_name, performed_by, details | rename time as "Time", action as "Action", search_name as "Dashboard", performed_by as "Performed By", details as "Details"
